name: Joint leave (cuti bersama)
authority: SKB 3 Menteri No. 1497 Tahun 2025, No. 2 Tahun 2025 and No. 5 Tahun 2025 — 8 cuti bersama days for 2026. For the private sector the SKB is guidance the employer implements, and a cuti bersama day taken is set against the annual leave entitlement. a cuti bersama day taken is set against the annual leave (SKB 3 Menteri; `consumes_code`).

name: Annual leave
authority: Law 13/2003 Art. 79(3) as amended by Law 6/2023 Window: each year of service (`SERVICE_YEAR`): UU 13/2003 art.79(3) grants 12 days after each 12 months of continuous work. Owner ruling (ID): the balance resets each leave year and at most 5 unused days carry into the next (`carry_forward`), once. On exit the unused, unlapsed balance is paid (PP 35/2021 art.40(4)(a)).

entitlement.days: size(bands.filter(b, service_months >= b.service_months).map(b, b.days)) > 0 ? first(bands.filter(b, service_months >= b.service_months).map(b, b.days)) : 0.0

name: Unpaid leave
authority: PP 36/2021 art.40(1) (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021): no wage for a day not worked — except the absences art.40(2)–(5) pays (illness, menstruation, family events, state duty, religious duty, union duty, company training, work withheld by the employer, rest and leave) and a suspension during dismissal (UU 13/2003 art.157A); an unpaid absence recorded with one of those reasons is refused. Breastfeeding time is working time (UU 13/2003 art.83; UU 4/2024 art.4(1)(c)) and is never booked as unpaid.

name: Medical leave
authority: PP 36/2021 arts.40(3)(a), 41(1) (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021): 100% of the wage for the first four months of illness, 75% for the next four, 50% for the next four and 25% thereafter until dismissal (`pay_fraction` by month_index; PARTIAL_PAY_LEAVE).

name: Maternity leave
authority: UU 13/2003 art.82(1); UU 4/2024 (KIA) art.4(3)(a): three months of maternity leave, and up to three more where a doctor certifies a special condition of mother or child (`leave.facts.special_condition_certified`); art.5(2): paid in full for the first four months and 75% for the fifth and sixth. Months beyond the entitlement are unpaid (pay_fraction 0). PP 36/2021 art.40(5)(d).

name: Paternity leave
authority: PP 36/2021 arts.40(3)(c)(5), 41(3)(e) (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021): two paid days when the wife gives birth or miscarries; UU 4/2024 art.6(1): two days for a birth, which may be extended by up to three more days or as agreed (PATERNITY_EXTENSION_LEAVE), two days for a miscarriage. Window EVENT.

name: Marriage leave
eligibility: has(entry.facts.event_kind) && entry.facts.event_kind in ["MARRIAGE"] && has(entry.facts.relationship) && entry.facts.relationship in ["SELF"]
authority: PP 36/2021 arts.40(3)(c), 41(3)(a) (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021): the paid days per event (3; window EVENT, `entry.facts.event_kind`, `entry.facts.relationship`); UU 13/2003 art.93(4) as amended by UU 6/2023.

name: Child's marriage leave
eligibility: has(entry.facts.event_kind) && entry.facts.event_kind in ["MARRIAGE"] && has(entry.facts.relationship) && entry.facts.relationship in ["CHILD"]
authority: PP 36/2021 arts.40(3)(c), 41(3)(b) (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021): the paid days per event (2; window EVENT, `entry.facts.event_kind`, `entry.facts.relationship`); UU 13/2003 art.93(4) as amended by UU 6/2023.

name: Child's circumcision leave
authority: PP 36/2021 arts.40(3)(c), 41(3)(c) (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021): the paid days per event (2; window EVENT, `entry.facts.event_kind`, `entry.facts.relationship`); UU 13/2003 art.93(4) as amended by UU 6/2023.

name: Child's baptism leave
authority: PP 36/2021 arts.40(3)(c), 41(3)(d) (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021): the paid days per event (2; window EVENT, `entry.facts.event_kind`, `entry.facts.relationship`); UU 13/2003 art.93(4) as amended by UU 6/2023.

name: Bereavement leave (immediate family)
eligibility: has(entry.facts.event_kind) && entry.facts.event_kind in ["DEATH"] && has(entry.facts.relationship) && entry.facts.relationship in ["SPOUSE", "CHILD", "PARENT", "PARENT_IN_LAW", "CHILD_IN_LAW"]
authority: PP 36/2021 arts.40(3)(c), 41(3)(f) (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021): the paid days per event (2; window EVENT, `entry.facts.event_kind`, `entry.facts.relationship`); UU 13/2003 art.93(4) as amended by UU 6/2023.

name: Bereavement leave (household member)
eligibility: has(entry.facts.event_kind) && entry.facts.event_kind in ["DEATH"] && has(entry.facts.relationship) && entry.facts.relationship in ["HOUSEHOLD"]
authority: PP 36/2021 arts.40(3)(c), 41(3)(g) (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021): the paid days per event (1; window EVENT, `entry.facts.event_kind`, `entry.facts.relationship`); UU 13/2003 art.93(4) as amended by UU 6/2023.

name: Menstrual leave
authority: PP 36/2021 arts.40(3)(b), 41(2) (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021): a female worker sick on the first and second days of menstruation is paid for the days taken, at most 2; UU 13/2003 art.81(1).

name: Miscarriage leave
eligibility: employee.gender == "FEMALE" && has(entry.facts.event_kind) && entry.facts.event_kind in ["MISCARRIAGE"] && (!has(entry.from) || !has(entry.to) || entry.to <= add_days(add_months(entry.from, 1), 14))
authority: UU 13/2003 art.82(2): 1.5 months of rest, or as the doctor or midwife certifies, after a miscarriage — read as one month and fifteen days from the first day (`entry.from`..`entry.to`); paid in full (PP 36/2021 art.40(5)(e), art.46, https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021); UU 4/2024 art.4(2)(b).

name: Cuti ibadah (religious duty leave)
eligibility: has(entry.facts.event_kind) && entry.facts.event_kind in ["RELIGIOUS_DUTY"] && !earlier.rows.exists(r, r.activity != "REVERSAL" && (!has(r.facts.event_id) || !has(entry.facts.event_id) || r.facts.event_id != entry.facts.event_id))
authority: PP 36/2021 arts.40(4)(b), 43 (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021): the wage is paid while the worker performs a religious duty their religion commands, only once during the employment with the company: a second event (another `facts.event_id`, or none) is refused.

name: Work accident or occupational disease leave
description: Absence after a work accident or occupational disease, while the worker cannot work (sementara tidak mampu bekerja).
authority: UU 13/2003 art.86; PP 44/2015 art.25 and Lampiran III as amended by PP 82/2019: while a worker is temporarily unable to work after a work accident or occupational disease the employer pays the wage (STMB) — 100% for the first 12 months, then 50% until recovery (secondary for the 50% tail; the official Lampiran could not be read) — and claims it back from BPJS Ketenagakerjaan.

name: State duty
authority: PP 36/2021 arts.40(4)(a), 42 (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021): a worker performing a duty to the state for at most one year is paid the shortfall between the state’s pay and the usual wage (`leave.facts.state_income_share`, the state’s pay as a share of that wage; pay_fraction 1 − share); the worker notifies in writing (art.42(3)).

name: Union duty
authority: PP 36/2021 arts.40(4)(c), 44 (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021): paid at the usual wage, with the employer’s consent shown by written notice (`entry.facts.employer_consent`).

name: Company education or training
authority: PP 36/2021 arts.40(4)(d), 45 (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021): paid at the usual wage.

name: Ready to work, no work provided
authority: PP 36/2021 art.40(2)(d) (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021): the worker was willing to do the agreed work but the employer did not employ them through its own fault or an avoidable obstacle — the wage is paid.

name: Suspension during dismissal (skorsing)
authority: UU 13/2003 art.157A(1)–(3) as added by UU 6/2023: until the dismissal is settled both parties keep their obligations; a suspended worker keeps the wage and other rights.

name: Paternity leave extension
eligibility: employee.gender == "MALE" && has(entry.facts.event_kind) && entry.facts.event_kind in ["BIRTH", "BIRTH_COMPLICATION"] && has(entry.facts.employer_agreed) && entry.facts.employer_agreed == true
authority: UU 4/2024 art.6(1)(a): the two days of a birth may be followed by up to three more days, or as agreed with the employer (`entry.facts.employer_agreed`); window EVENT, 3 days.

name: Long leave (istirahat panjang)
authority: UU 13/2003 art.79(5) as amended by UU 6/2023: long leave as the employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement grants it (`company.facts.long_leave_granted`); PP 36/2021 arts.40(5)(c), 46 (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021): paid at the usual wage.
